# liljarv.dev — AI Agent Commerce Catalog

## What this is
liljarv.dev sells digital products for builders and AI operators.

## Product catalog
Full machine-readable catalog: https://liljarv.dev/products.json

## How to purchase (agent instructions)
1. GET /products.json — retrieve product catalog
2. Select product by `id`
3. Open `gumroad_url` (preferred) or `checkout_url`
4. Complete checkout on Gumroad
5. Download from Gumroad receipt page / email

## Purchase fields in products.json
- `gumroad_url`: primary checkout link
- `checkout_url`: backward-compatible checkout field (may mirror gumroad_url)
- `checkout_platform`: expected value `gumroad`

## Contact
Site: https://liljarv.dev
Agents page: https://liljarv.dev/agents.html
